Ashish Agarwal	Engineering Leader| Java, Spring, Microservices & Cloud expert

Phone: (+91) 9650-617-778	LinkedIn: ashish-agarwal-11367264

E-mail: ashish.pec11@gmail.com

	Git : https://github.com/ashishagg01

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Innovative and performance-focused Engineering Leader with over a decade of experience in Java , Spring, microservices, and cloud-native architectures. Adept at building scalable, secure, and highly available applications using Spring Boot, REST, and modern DevOps tools. Strong background in design patterns, multithreading, and distributed systems. Known for delivering complex solutions with high code quality, technical mentoring, and architecture governance in Agile environments.

LEADERSHIP AND MANAGEMENT HIGHLIGHTS

TeaW ManageWent: Lead a team of 15+ engineers including backend, DevOps, and QA. Responsible for hiring, mentoring, performance reviews, and career development.

Scrum & Agile Delivery: Successfully drove Agile practices with sprint-based delivery, backlog grooming, and regular retrospectives; ensured on-time delivery with quality.

Stakeholder Alignment: Regularly collaborate with product, business, and operations teams to translate requirements into deliverables and align tech with strategy.

Quality Ownership: Enforced engineering best practices, including code reviews, TDD, CI/CD pipelines, and production monitoring, improving uptime and performance SLAs.

Strategic Initiatives: Championed dedupe optimization, modular platformization, and chatbot automation, improving customer onboarding, system reliability, and operational efficiency.

Innovation Focus: Encouraged and executed PoCs with AI agents and asynchronous communication paradigms, positioning platforms for future-ready scalability.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Java Frameworks : Spring Boot, Apache Camel, Rest and SOAP API, JPA, Hibernate

Databases : Postgres, MongoDB, Mysql, CouchDB, Hazelcast, Aerospike, Oracle

CI/CD Tools : Maven, Gradle, SVN, GIT, Jenkins, Sonar, Grafana, Kibana, AppDynamic, NewRelic

SAAS and Cloud : Mulesoft, Apigee, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Kong API Gateway

Message Broker : Rabbit MQ, Active MQ , Kafka, Solace, WebSphere MQ

AI Frameworks : Langchain , LangGraph, NLTK , Agno , Crew AI , Generative AI , Agentic AI



WORK EXPERIENCE

Bharti Airtel	DGM (Technical Manager)	(Oct 2021 - PRESENT)

Aťrtel AcQuť3ťtťon PlatforW (eActťvate App) : Leading cross-functional development of the Airtel Acquisition Platform—a nationwide, high-scale lead fulfillment system used by 50,000+ agents, enabling unified onboarding across Broadband, Mobility, DTH, XSafe, and Airtel Black services. Architected and executed the platform's Platformization strategy, improving modularity, reducing code duplication, and enabling 30% faster rollout of new LOBs.

Delivered multiple mission-critical modules, contributing over 50% of the codebase and overseeing complete delivery lifecycle—from requirements and design to deployment and post-release support.

Championed major performance and reliability enhancements, including:

Proactive monitoring and alerting setup via AppDynamics, Kibana, Grafana

Reduced incident turnaround time by 40%, while improving system uptime and SLA adherence

Led tuning efforts that improved API latency by 20% during peak load conditions

Drove a Dedupe Optimization Project that resolved identity conflicts across multiple acquisition channels, leading to:

40% reduction in customer onboarding churn

Enhanced downstream data consistency across billing, CRM, and analytics systems

Mentored a team of 15+ engineers across Backend and DevOps, fostering a culture of ownership, code quality, and delivery excellence Regularly interfaced with product managers, operations leads, and QA to align engineering outcomes with Airtel’s digital growth strategy

Chatbot : Building a self-serve, omnichannel bot platform to create human-like conversations powered by Rasa, AI and NLP in a quick and hassle-free manner. Overall 70% reduction in the manual SRs. 90% of journey creation work can be done without dev support. It has scalable architecture leading to minimal failure & 99.99% uptime.

Onlťne Recharge3 : Building a common platform for Airtel customers for all types of recharges (Prepaid, DTH, LCO, Datacard). A microservice based architecture using spring boot and mongodb as the basic building blocks. Uplifted the technology stack from synchronous to asynchronous and blended the global distributed cache with in-memory. It helps in reducing the 50% of compute for serving the various endpoints of recharges and also maintaining the 99th percentile below 500 ms at average tps of ~1000.

To The New	Technical Lead	(Nov 2017 - Oct 2021)

S)Wphon) Talent : Build bi-directional integrations with different ATS like Workday, UKG, ADP, Greenhouse. Prepare the HLDs and LLDs for different integrations. Use Mulesoft and Apache Camel for creating the reusable system and process APIs and create the multi-tenant solution.Created reusable components to reduce repeated dev efforts by 70% to 80%.

HÐFC Mutual Fund3 : Microservice based architecture using spring boot and rabbitMQ. Build features like e-cart, e-mandate. Integrate the payment gateways like billdesk and billjunction. Build integrations with CAMS and CVL APIs. Implement distributed cache using Hazelcast.

Accenture	Application Development Sr Analyst	(Oct 2012 - Feb 2017)

Marrťott Hotel3 : API Development, Unit testing, Integration Testing, Release support and Validations. Build the performant APIs using caching . Used couchDB for storing the user related information like cart values and other booking related information. Used multi level caching to reduce 70% of network calls. Implemented parallel processing of Junits to reduce the overall application uptime by 30%.

EDUCATION Master of Engineering PEC, Chandigarh (Aug 2009 - Jun 2011) Bachelor in Technology UPTU, Lucknow (Aug 2005 - Jun 2009)



CERTIFICATIONS

Agentic AI - Building Agentic AI And Generative AI Application With Cloud.	( Jan 2025 to Present)

Mulesoft - MuleSoft Certified Developer - Level 1.	( Oct 2021 to Oct 2023 )

Google Cloud - Apigee Certified API Engineer.	( Jan 2021 to Jan 2023 )

Kubernetes Crash Course for Java Developers.	( 2019 )

Master Microservices with Spring Boot and Spring Cloud.	(2018 )

Agile Professional Certified.	( 2016 )

Oracle Certified Professional , Java SE6 Programmer.	( 2013 )

ACHIEVEMENTS

Stand Out Performance Recognition Award in Geek Combat 2021 .

Impact Award - FY 2020 - 2021 - Q1 .

Orion Award (Eminence and Excellence Recognition 2012 & 2013) .
